 class TestEdition:
+    def test_from_isbn_imports_staged_data_locally(self, monkeypatch):
+        from openlibrary.catalog import add_book
+
+        calls = []
+        book = object()
+
+        class Site:
+            def things(self, query):
+                return []
+
+            def get(self, key):
+                assert key == '/books/OL1M'
+                return book
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(web.ctx, 'site', Site(), raising=False)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(web.ctx, 'env', {}, raising=False)
+        record = {
+            'title': 'Example',
+            'isbn_13': ['9781234567897'],
+            'source_records': ['amazon:9781234567897'],
+            'authors': [{'name': 'Example Author'}],
+            'publishers': ['Example Publisher'],
+            'publish_date': '2020',
+        }
+        row = web.storage(
+            ia_id='amazon:9781234567897',
+            data=json.dumps(record),
+        )
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            models.ImportItem,
+            'find_staged_or_pending',
+            staticmethod(lambda identifiers: [row]),
+        )
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            models.ImportItem,
+            'set_status',
+            lambda self, status, ol_key: calls.append(('status', status, ol_key)),
+        )
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            add_book,
+            'load',
+            lambda edition: calls.append(('load', edition)) or {
+                'success': True,
+                'edition': {'status': 'created', 'key': '/books/OL1M'},

+        )
+

+        assert calls == [
+            ('load', record),
+            ('status', 'created', '/books/OL1M'),
+        ]
+
     def mock_edition(self, edition_class):
         data = {"key": "/books/OL1M", "type": {"key": "/type/edition"}, "title": "foo"}
         return edition_class(MockSite(), "/books/OL1M", data=data)
